== The Emerald City of Oz ==

Omby Amby is a companion on a journey through the Land of Oz, traveling alongside Dorothy, Uncle Henry, the Wizard, and the Shaggy Man. During a puzzle-solving episode, he proves observant and helpful, discovering scattered pieces — including a hand holding a knitting needle and, later, a mouth — that others use to reassemble figures such as old Larry and Grandmother Gnit. He is knowledgeable about the geography and customs of Oz, explaining to the group that Flutterbudget Center and Rigmarole Town are known as "the Defensive Settlements of Oz."

When a cry for help is heard, Omby Amby joins the Wizard, Uncle Henry, and the Shaggy Man in leaping from the wagon to come to a stranger's aid. In an exchange with a man afraid to sleep for fear his eyes might grow shut, Omby Amby responds with plain, direct questioning, asking why the man cannot sleep and whether he had ever heard of such a thing happening.
